# TRANSITIVE INCLUDES.  Six of the ten carry
# whose eight .svh headers are inputs too:

#      filelist bytes, the same core-et pin, the same reader and the same
#      options.  If the emitted source differs, that is a REAL pipeline byte
#      mismatch and is retained as one, with attribution to whichever stage the
#      evidence supports -- it is NOT discarded because the intermediate graphs
#   B. IDENTICAL GRAPH HANDOFF.  Run steps 1-2 once, then step 3 on both sides
#      against the SAME $LG_NORM directory.  This isolates the emitter from the
#      frontend.  PREREQUISITE, unverified: the on-disk GraphLibrary written by
#      one binary must be readable by the other.  That is a format-compatibility
#      question between the pin and master and is NOT assumed here.
